description: How the customer roles around a BI dashboard extensions platform relate to each other: who builds dashboards for whom, who asks whom for write-back and reports, how the platform lead, IT administrator and security reviewer hand work and approvals to each other, how executives steer the platform investment, and how partners sell into and implement for the platform team.

relationTypes.name: Commercial
relationTypes.description: Subscriptions, renewals, partner deals and budget decisions

relationTypes.name: Operational
relationTypes.description: Day-to-day dashboard requests, installations, configuration and support hand-offs

relationTypes.name: Financial
relationTypes.description: Forecasts, budgets, targets and management statements entered and reported through dashboards

relationTypes.name: Information
relationTypes.description: Dashboards, reports, usage evidence, security evidence and approvals

relations.name: Publishes interactive dashboards
relations.description: Builds and publishes the dashboard with SuperTables, ShowMeMore, PictureThis and HierarchyFilter configured so the viewer can pivot, group, filter and export without a new request; adds DashboardGuide overlays to explain it.

relations.name: Requests dashboards and changes
relations.description: Asks for new views, columns, exports and fixes; the creator answers with self-service configuration where possible and a new dashboard only where needed, which is the request queue the creator's north star measures.

relations.name: Delivers write-back and finance dashboards
relations.description: Configures WriteBackExtreme, InputTables and FinanceTables forms, schemas, validations and approval steps so the planner can enter forecasts, budgets and comments and produce P&Ls inside the dashboard.

relations.name: Submits plans and management statements
relations.description: Enters and revises forecasts, budgets and targets with an audit trail and hands the resulting P&Ls, budget-versus-actual reports and KPI packs to the executive for approval and steering.

relations.name: Enables and governs dashboard creators
relations.description: Safelists extensions, assigns licences and seats, sets configuration standards, runs the centre of excellence and asks creators for usage evidence and guided onboarding on published dashboards.

relations.name: Reports adoption and delivers scheduled reports
relations.description: Schedules MailScheduler deliveries to email, Teams and Slack, curates the PowerKPIs entry point and reports monthly active users and adoption evidence to justify the platform investment.

relations.name: Approves the extensions budget and renewal
relations.description: Sets the adoption and self-service ambition, approves the Professional or Enterprise subscription, the purchase order and the renewal on the basis of the usage and outcome evidence the platform lead presents.

relations.name: Requests deployment and upgrades
relations.description: Hands over the Enterprise licence, the required extensions, versions and database connections and asks IT to install, upgrade and keep the self-hosted runtime available and every workbook pointed at the right extension URL.

relations.name: Provides the runtime, SSO and connections
relations.description: Installs the extensions with ExtensionsManager, configures SSO, roles and database connections, publishes the extension URLs and runs TrexReplacer so creators can build against a working, current environment.

relations.name: Assesses the vendor and approves safelisting
relations.description: Reviews ISO 27001 evidence, penetration-test reports, data flows, the on-premises option and the audit trail, sets the Full Data Access decision per extension and signs off the safelist entry and data processing agreement.

relations.name: Supplies deployment and audit evidence
relations.description: Documents the self-hosted architecture, network isolation, identity integration and write-back audit logs the reviewer needs for the assessment and for auditors asking who changed which number when.

relations.name: Sells and renews extension subscriptions
relations.description: Recommends the extensions in the client's language and region, registers the deal, runs demos with trial licences, quotes the Professional or Enterprise plan and manages the renewal for margin.

relations.name: Implements and hands over the deployment
relations.description: Installs and configures the Enterprise extensions, migrates workbooks, trains the administrator and hands over runbooks, then escalates vendor issues through partner support.

relations.name: Builds and trains on extension dashboards
relations.description: Delivers the first dashboards with SuperTables, write-back forms and KPI entry points, trains the client's creators on configuration patterns and shares templates and demo workbooks.
